critical_code_review_comments: The fix at NarrativeRx.iss line 60 correctly matches the workflow copy at build-installer.yml line 94 (Copy-Item installer\payload-static\* installer\payload\). If payload-static/ ever accumulates more files, the current wildcard workflow copy would silently pack them into the folder but the .iss [Files] section would still need explicit Source: lines. Consider either (a) adding a Source: "payload\*"; Excludes: ... catch-all, or (b) documenting the convention that any new payload-static/ file must be explicitly listed in [Files] — the exact bug that just happened with open-narrative-rx.bat.

Suggest changing workflow to Copy-Item windows\* (all files) or being explicit.
